motor_brake_lump.policy: Exclude all inserted motor-reference solids from part mass calculation. One replaceable parameterized 4.54 kg lump covers all four selected motor/brake references; reference geometry does not add mass again.
motor_brake_lump.shape_CG_policy: Estimate aggregate park CG/inertia from four reference placements; no measured motor/brake CG or inertia. Lump attached to carousel_mount in v1; moving Z-motor mass redistribution during X travel is approximated.

aircraft.status: Eight separate models at 0.5 kg catalogue reference each; supplied-build mass unmeasured.

crawler.missing_internal_mass_policy: Subtract material-estimated retained CAD parts and explicitly allocated contact proxies from published dry reference. Represent positive residual as one clearly identified internal-mass estimate. Add battery reference once. These are simulation assumptions, not a weighed crawler or verified mass distribution.

inertia_policy: Native per-body homogeneous shape CG/central inertia normalized to assigned material/catalogue mass, then transformed and combined with the parallel-axis theorem. No native/default root mass accepted. No negative off-diagonal sign correction: API returns tensor entries already signed.
budget_policy: Incomplete physical mass reconciliation only; weight/reserve optimization and budget closure remain deferred.
